scenarios.title: An airbent card can be cast by its owner for {2} while it stays exiled
decisions: A casts Airbending Lesson targeting Hill Giant, tapping the three Plains.
Both players pass; Airbending Lesson resolves: Hill Giant is airbent (exiled) and A draws Forest.
A attempts to cast Hill Giant from exile for {2}, tapping both Mountains.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: Hill Giant is exiled by Airbending Lesson. Casting it from exile is legal for A, its owner, with a cost of {2} instead of {3}{R}. Hill Giant resolves onto the battlefield under A's control; A has Forest in hand.

variants.label: opponent_owned
variants.delta: The target is B's Hill Giant, on B's battlefield, instead of A's.
variants.expected: Hill Giant is exiled. A's attempt to cast it from exile is not legal, because only its owner B may cast it for {2}; it stays in exile. B could cast it for {2} on B's own turn.

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge implements the permission as a command-zone effect with MayPlayAltManaCost$ 2 for the exiled card; it ends when the card leaves exile or is cast.

scenarios.title: Airbending triggers abilities only when something was exiled

setup.notes: Libraries are listed top first. Avatar Aang has 'Whenever you waterbend, earthbend, firebend, or airbend, draw a card' and is not summoning sick.

decisions: A casts Glider Staff, tapping the three Plains.
Both players pass; Glider Staff resolves and enters.
Glider Staff's enters trigger targets B's Grizzly Bears; both players pass.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears is airbent: it moves from B's battlefield to exile. Avatar Aang's trigger fires and A draws Forest.

variants.label: no_target
variants.delta: Glider Staff's enters trigger is put on the stack with no target chosen.
variants.expected: Nothing is airbent: Grizzly Bears stays on B's battlefield. Avatar Aang's trigger does not fire and A draws no card.

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge fires the Airbend elemental-bend trigger only when its zone-movement table is non-empty after the exile.
